name: derschutze

prices.note: US market prices (country=US; base EUR, e.g. riot hoodie €98 = $117). Hoodies and zip-ups in the tops collection, kids and knit zips excluded: 42, all regular price. Regular = no variant with compare_at_price above price; tags without a compare-at price are not markdowns.

notes: Homepage meta description: 'clothing brand based in Hamburg'. Story page: founded by Yusuf Arif Yücel, a German designer with Turkish roots who grew up in East Hamburg (no year on the page).
Stores page: London (27 Peter St), New York (22 Spring St, NY 10012), Berlin. US store, so us_stores true.
Shipping to the US: €23.99 flat (may rise up to €10 by cart volume); no free-shipping threshold stated. Returns: 14 days after receipt.

Hoodie descriptions mostly 480gsm (16) or 460gsm (9); e.g. 'won' Hoodie black $106 (480gsm, 80/20 preshrunk cotton, made in Türkiye), 'riot' Hoodie black $117. Sizes small–xxlarge on all 42, xsmall on 14.
